items: Sports uses your country as well as your language: a UK viewer gets UK channels for a match, never US ones.
New Language and Country setting in Playback.
Live TV shows a green 4K tag only on channels that really are 4K; the 1080p, 720p and SD labels are gone.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
